notes:
Your handwriting and the page now appear together.

**Opening a piece used to show its handwriting a moment before the music itself.** For a fraction of a second the incoming page's markings were drawn over the page you were leaving, until the new page finished loading underneath them. The markings are now held back until the page they belong to is ready, so the two arrive together.

Nothing was ever misplaced — the markings were always on the right page, they were just shown a beat too early.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
